_doc: What /diag (Web/diag.html) probes live from the browser. Paths are relative to Web/ (the page's base). Web/build.py fails the build when a listed file is not in the bundle or a bundled game file is not covered by a check. probe: fetch (GET, size, not an LFS pointer), files (GET every url), wasm (GET + WebAssembly.compile), mujoco (load the MuJoCo WASM module, compile an arena, step it), onnx (one brain's inference on a zero observation), matchups (every arena, fingerprint, card and brain loader.js names), webgl2 (a WebGL2 context), version (the game page carries this page's build stamp).
